**Explicit evaluation of the q -Stokes matrices for certain conﬂuent hypergeometric q -diﬀerence equations**

*Jinghong Lin, Yiming Ma and Xiaomeng Xu*

28 pp, 17 sections.

**Abstract.** We prove a connection formula for the basic hypergeomtric function nϕn−1 (a1, ..., an−1, 0; b1, ..., bn−1; q, z) by using the q-Borel resummation. As an application, we compute q-Stokes matrices of a special conﬂuent hypergeometric q-diﬀerence system with an irregular singularity. We show that by letting q →1, the q-Stokes matrices recover the known expressions of the Stokes matrices of the corresponding conﬂuent hypergeometric diﬀerential system.
